sources.population: FitnessVolt site tiers ('estimated standards'); site claims a model built from verified competition results plus reader data still building - population is unclear, not a pure gym-goer survey

sources.name: AthletePath
sources.population: not stated; fixed bodyweight-ratio bands (men: untrained <0.4x, novice 0.4-0.6x, intermediate 0.6-0.85x, advanced 0.85-1.15x, elite >=1.15x)
sources.notes: Formula-like ratio table (values = ratio x bodyweight), not an observed population distribution. Female table not seen.

sources.name: Endura (endura.coach)
sources.population: not stated; app/calculator benchmarks on estimated 1RM
sources.mapping: Each value = lower bound of the named band (Novice 55-82 -> Novice threshold 55, etc.). Beginner band is 'under X' so no Beginner threshold (null). Endura also has a 'Stretch' band above Elite (men 180: 183+, women 150: 127+), ignored.
sources.notes: Band-lower-bound mapping is my interpretation; Endura's 'Elite' sits well below FitnessVolt/Strength Level Elite.

sources.name: The Workout Mag
sources.population: men by training experience (novice 6-12 mo, intermediate 1-3 yr, advanced 3-5 yr)
sources.mapping: Novice->Novice, Intermediate->Intermediate, Advanced->Advanced (experience-based, not percentile; mapping loose)
sources.notes: Experience-based tiers, ~0.6/0.8/1.0x bodyweight; much higher than all other sources at Novice/Intermediate.

strength_level_check.differs_from_app: none (male 180 row matches app exactly; SL kg table 90 kg female = 12/20/30/43/57 kg -> 26/44/66/95/126 lb at 198 lb bw, consistent with app 200-lb row 26/44/67/94/125; 110 kg male = 31/44/60/78/97 kg -> 68/97/132/172/214 lb at 243 lb bw, consistent with app 240-lb row 67/95/130/170/214). Note: SL community-wide (not bw-specific) male figures seen as 38/66/103/149/201 on some pages and 42/67/99/138/180 on others - different page snapshots.

Barbell Curl.summary: FitnessVolt broadly agrees with the app: Beginner ~5-15% lower, Novice equal, Intermediate +2-5%, Advanced +7-9%, Elite +10-11% (male 180: 44/72/108/151/199 vs app 49/73/104/140/180). AthletePath (ratio formula) agrees at Novice/Intermediate; Endura is lower at the top, The Workout Mag much higher at Novice/Intermediate.
